technology_name: Raw Banana Grits for Porridges Production Technology
institution: CSIR-National Institute for Interdisciplinary Science and Technology (NIIST)
problem_solved: Need for low-glycemic functional foods for diabetes management using value-added banana products.
description: Processes for the development of dehydrated and powdered raw banana functional breakfast mixes, such as grits for porridges. The technology utilizes green banana pulp, which contains up to 70-80% starch, processed using size reduction devices, milling, boiling, and drying equipment to create functional health foods.
applications: • Manufacturing of commercial therapeutic breakfast porridges • Processing of low-glycemic health-mix grits • Production of clean-label instant packaged hot cereals • Value-addition processing loops for commercial banana farming
